headline: Growth holds up but sequential margins compress
summary_short: Revenue was $1,400.1M, up 7.6% y/y though down 0.5% q/q; net margin compressed roughly 190bp sequentially while diluted EPS rose 18.8% y/y on a smaller share count.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,400.1M, +7.6% y/y and -0.5% q/q. Gross margin was 27.7% (+85bp y/y, -235bp q/q); operating margin 8.3% (+71bp y/y, -226bp q/q). Diluted EPS was $1.52, +18.8% y/y and -23.2% q/q, aided by a 5.4% y/y reduction in diluted share count. Operating cash flow swung to -$36.4M from +$24.2M a year ago; cash fell to $1,037.0M from $1,296.1M q/q.
